title: The Fool
upright: Begin with trust; make room for surprise.
reversed: A leap made to escape; innocence without attention.
interpretation: A new path asks for curiosity and a small act of courage. Look down long enough to choose your footing, then move.
reflection: What could you begin before you feel entirely ready?

title: The Magician
upright: Gather your tools and act with intention.
reversed: Scattered energy; skill used for display.
interpretation: The resources are already on the table. Name the result you want and bring attention, word, and hand into alignment.
reflection: Which tool in your reach have you overlooked?

title: The High Priestess
upright: Listen beneath the obvious; honor what is hidden.
reversed: Doubt in your intuition; a secret kept too long.
interpretation: Pause before forcing an answer. A quiet pattern is becoming visible through dreams, timing, and what remains unsaid.
reflection: What do you know when you stop arguing with yourself?

title: The Empress
upright: Nourish what wants to grow.
reversed: Overgiving; comfort that keeps you still.
interpretation: Creation needs warmth, rhythm, and room. Tend the body and the place that makes your work possible.
reflection: What would flourish with steadier care?

title: The Emperor
upright: Give your vision a durable shape.
reversed: Rigidity; control mistaken for safety.
interpretation: A clear boundary can protect what matters. Build a structure that serves people and can be revised when life changes.
reflection: What rule supports your freedom, and what rule limits it?

title: The Hierophant
upright: Learn from a lineage; test its wisdom in life.
reversed: Unexamined convention; rejecting guidance on reflex.
interpretation: A teacher, ritual, or shared practice can offer a language for your experience. Keep the part that makes you more awake.
reflection: Which inherited practice deserves a fresh question?

title: The Lovers
upright: Choose in alignment with your values.
reversed: A split desire; an agreement made without honesty.
interpretation: Attraction is only the beginning. Let a meaningful choice reflect who you are becoming and what you can offer in truth.
reflection: What choice lets your heart and actions agree?

title: The Chariot
upright: Direct opposing forces toward one aim.
reversed: Momentum without direction; forcing an outcome.
interpretation: You do not need every feeling to agree before moving. Hold the reins with purpose and adjust as the terrain answers back.
reflection: What deserves your full direction now?

title: Strength
upright: Meet intensity with patience and brave tenderness.
reversed: Suppressed anger; courage worn as a mask.
interpretation: Real strength can stay present with a difficult instinct without crushing it. Gentleness gives courage a longer life.
reflection: Where would a softer grip make you stronger?

title: The Hermit
upright: Step back to hear your own signal.
reversed: Isolation that closes the door to help.
interpretation: Solitude can turn experience into wisdom. Carry a small light, and return with what it shows you.
reflection: What becomes clear when the noise recedes?

title: Wheel of Fortune
upright: Notice the turning; respond to the moment.
reversed: Resistance to change; surrendering your agency to chance.
interpretation: Conditions shift beyond any single hand. Find the choice available within the turning rather than demanding that the wheel stop.
reflection: What can you influence inside a changing season?

title: Justice
upright: Look at the facts and make a fair repair.
reversed: Avoiding consequences; a verdict without context.
interpretation: Clarity asks you to weigh actions and effects together. A just response is accountable, proportionate, and open to evidence.
reflection: What truth would improve this decision?

title: The Hanged Man
upright: Pause and let a different angle appear.
reversed: Stalling disguised as surrender; needless sacrifice.
interpretation: A pause can loosen an old assumption. Release the urge to solve everything at once and notice what changes when you turn the question around.
reflection: What can you see from the position you resisted?

title: Death
upright: Let an ending make space for life.
reversed: Clinging to a finished form; fear of transition.
interpretation: Something has completed its work. Grieve what deserves grief, then clear a place for the next honest shape.
reflection: What is ready to be honored and released?

title: Temperance
upright: Blend differences at a sustainable pace.
reversed: Excess; a forced compromise that serves no one.
interpretation: Integration is an active craft. Move between two needs carefully until a workable rhythm emerges.
reflection: Which extremes could become a useful rhythm?

title: The Devil
upright: Name the bond that narrows your choices.
reversed: Shame after escape; a pattern beginning to loosen.
interpretation: A habit can feel permanent while still having a clasp. Examine what it offers you, what it costs, and where your hand can open it.
reflection: What attachment asks to be seen clearly?

title: The Tower
upright: Let the false structure fall; protect what is alive.
reversed: Fear of disruption; rebuilding on the same fracture.
interpretation: A sudden truth can shake a carefully built story. Tend the immediate needs first, then build with materials that can bear reality.
reflection: What truth is asking for a safer foundation?

title: The Star
upright: Restore hope through small, steady acts.
reversed: Exhaustion; losing sight of available support.
interpretation: After upheaval, the future may arrive as a trickle rather than a trumpet. Refill what is depleted and let simplicity count.
reflection: What small source of renewal is already near?

title: The Moon
upright: Travel gently through uncertainty.
reversed: Confusion hardened into fear; a story mistaken for fact.
interpretation: The path is real even when its edges blur. Check your senses, allow dreams to speak, and wait for daylight before making a final claim.
reflection: What uncertainty can you hold without inventing certainty?

title: The Sun
upright: Share the joy of what is plainly alive.
reversed: Overexposure; pressure to feel cheerful.
interpretation: A bright moment deserves to be received without apology. Let warmth make you generous, and give your success room to breathe.
reflection: What can you celebrate without explaining it away?

title: Judgement
upright: Answer a call to change with honesty.
reversed: Self-condemnation; ignoring a needed reckoning.
interpretation: Review the past without living there. Take responsibility, claim what you learned, and step into the next version of your life.
reflection: What part of your life is asking for a clear answer?

title: The World
upright: Complete the circle and inhabit the wider view.
reversed: A threshold delayed; closing before the lesson lands.
interpretation: A cycle has become whole enough to release. Name what you made, thank what carried you, and notice the new horizon inside the ending.
reflection: What completion are you ready to acknowledge?

title: Ace of Wands
upright: A spark invites committed action.
reversed: Enthusiasm without a place to land.
interpretation: The first flame is enough to begin a modest experiment. Give the idea a task before it fades into possibility.
reflection: What could you try today at a small scale?

title: Two of Wands
upright: Survey the horizon and choose a direction.
reversed: Planning that never crosses the doorway.
interpretation: You can see beyond your present walls. Compare the paths, then make one concrete commitment to the wider world.
reflection: Which option grows when you actually test it?

title: Three of Wands
upright: Watch for the return of an effort sent outward.
reversed: Impatience; expectations that ignore distance.
interpretation: The work has left your hands and begun a journey of its own. Stay ready to receive feedback and adjust the next shipment.
reflection: What response are you waiting for, and how can you prepare?

title: Four of Wands
upright: Make a place for shared celebration.
reversed: A milestone missed; belonging that feels conditional.
interpretation: A threshold deserves a pause. Welcome the people who helped and let the structure of home hold the joy.
reflection: Who belongs at the table for this moment?

title: Five of Wands
upright: Meet friction without making an enemy of it.
reversed: Conflict avoided until it hardens.
interpretation: Many energies are crossing at once. Set a fair rule for the exchange and look for the useful difference beneath the noise.
reflection: What would make this disagreement constructive?

title: Six of Wands
upright: Receive recognition and keep moving with grace.
reversed: Approval hunger; success worn like armor.
interpretation: Let the accomplishment be visible. Thank the team and remember that applause is a moment, not a compass.
reflection: How can you accept praise without depending on it?

title: Seven of Wands
upright: Hold your ground with a clear reason.
reversed: Defending everything; vigilance without rest.
interpretation: Your position may need a boundary. Choose what truly warrants the effort and let minor challenges pass.
reflection: Which principle is worth defending now?

title: Eight of Wands
upright: Act while the opening is clear.
reversed: Haste that outruns understanding.
interpretation: Momentum has arrived. Keep messages simple, check the landing place, and let the useful speed carry the work.
reflection: What can move quickly once you remove one delay?

title: Nine of Wands
upright: Protect your energy without closing your heart.
reversed: Exhaustion; expecting every visitor to be a threat.
interpretation: Experience has made you watchful. Honor the wound and set a boundary that still lets help through.
reflection: Where do you need rest before another push?

title: Ten of Wands
upright: Set down a burden that no longer belongs to you.
reversed: Overload defended as duty.
interpretation: The goal is near, but the bundle is heavy. Redistribute the work or question which pieces ever needed carrying.
reflection: What responsibility can be shared or released?

title: Page of Wands
upright: Follow a lively question into the field.
reversed: A promising idea left untested.
interpretation: Curiosity is a useful guide when paired with attention. Explore, ask, and bring back one observation worth keeping.
reflection: What are you excited to learn firsthand?

title: Knight of Wands
upright: Bring bold energy to a worthy pursuit.
reversed: Rushing past people or details.
interpretation: A brave move can break inertia. Let courage travel with a map and enough room for others to respond.
reflection: Where can boldness become useful action?

title: Queen of Wands
upright: Lead through warmth, confidence, and invitation.
reversed: Performing certainty; neglecting your own fire.
interpretation: Your presence can make other people braver. Tend your own source of energy as you make room for theirs.
reflection: How can you make confidence contagious today?

title: King of Wands
upright: Steward a vision and empower its makers.
reversed: Dominating the plan; impatience with process.
interpretation: See the long arc and set a clear standard. The strongest fire gives others light enough to build beside it.
reflection: What vision needs steady leadership rather than force?

title: Ace of Cups
upright: Open to a feeling that wants honest expression.
reversed: Emotional overflow; a heart held shut.
interpretation: A new emotional current is here. Make a vessel for it through conversation, art, or a quiet act of care.
reflection: What feeling deserves a safe place to land?

title: Two of Cups
upright: Meet another person in mutual respect.
reversed: An imbalance hidden by chemistry.
interpretation: Connection deepens when each person can be seen. Offer what is true and listen for what the other can truly offer.
reflection: Where could reciprocity become clearer?

title: Three of Cups
upright: Let friendship multiply delight.
reversed: Feeling outside the circle; celebration postponed.
interpretation: Good news grows when shared. Reach for the people who can celebrate freely and make room for their stories too.
reflection: Who would enjoy this moment with you?

title: Four of Cups
upright: Look again at an offer before dismissing it.
reversed: Apathy; chasing novelty to avoid feeling.
interpretation: A pause may be needed, but numbness can hide a useful invitation. Check what you need before turning away.
reflection: What have you stopped noticing nearby?

title: Five of Cups
upright: Honor loss while noticing what remains.
reversed: Grief denied; hope used to rush healing.
interpretation: Something mattered and is gone. Give sorrow its real space, then turn gently toward the cups that still stand.
reflection: What support remains within reach as you grieve?

title: Six of Cups
upright: Let memory offer comfort and perspective.
reversed: Nostalgia that edits out the whole story.
interpretation: An old kindness may still nourish you. Enjoy the memory and ask what it teaches your present life.
reflection: Which memory can guide you without trapping you?

title: Seven of Cups
upright: Sort enticing possibilities from living choices.
reversed: Fantasy replacing commitment.
interpretation: Many images compete for your attention. Name the real cost and next step for each before choosing one to pursue.
reflection: Which dream can survive a practical question?

title: Eight of Cups
upright: Leave a familiar vessel when it no longer holds you.
reversed: Walking away before speaking honestly.
interpretation: You may have gathered all this place can give. Depart with care, and carry the learning instead of a silent grievance.
reflection: What would you gain by leaving with clarity?

title: Nine of Cups
upright: Take pleasure in enoughness.
reversed: Indulgence that masks an unmet need.
interpretation: Satisfaction can be a practice. Notice what is good without making the day prove that everything is perfect.
reflection: What is already enough for one moment?

title: Ten of Cups
upright: Nurture the bonds that make joy durable.
reversed: Idealizing harmony; quiet needs left unsaid.
interpretation: The image of a happy home is built from everyday care. Ask what each person needs and celebrate what already connects you.
reflection: What small act would strengthen belonging?

title: Page of Cups
upright: Welcome a surprising message from the heart.
reversed: Mood mistaken for a promise.
interpretation: A tender thought may arrive in an odd form. Stay curious, then give it a clear and kind expression.
reflection: What emotion is trying to speak creatively?

title: Knight of Cups
upright: Offer devotion with both poetry and follow through.
reversed: Charm without commitment; idealizing another.
interpretation: A heartfelt invitation deserves a real path. Say what you mean and let actions confirm the beauty of your words.
reflection: How can you make a sincere gesture concrete?

title: Queen of Cups
upright: Hold feeling with empathy and healthy edges.
reversed: Absorbing every feeling around you.
interpretation: Your sensitivity is perceptive. Give it a shore: listen deeply while remembering what belongs to you.
reflection: Where does care need a boundary?

title: King of Cups
upright: Lead with emotional steadiness.
reversed: Control disguised as calm; feelings kept offshore.
interpretation: You can be moved without being swept away. Make room for emotion and respond from a considered center.
reflection: What feeling can you acknowledge before deciding?

title: Ace of Swords
upright: Cut through confusion with a useful truth.
reversed: Sharpness without care; certainty before evidence.
interpretation: A clear idea can open the way. Test it honestly and speak it in a form that others can hear.
reflection: What truth needs a precise, kind sentence?

title: Two of Swords
upright: Make space to decide what you are avoiding.
reversed: False peace; information kept outside the room.
interpretation: A stalemate can protect you briefly, but it cannot choose for you. Gather one missing fact and loosen the crossed guard.
reflection: What fact would help you choose?

title: Three of Swords
upright: Name the hurt and tend it directly.
reversed: Pain revisited without care; healing hurried.
interpretation: Heartbreak is real data about what mattered. Give it words, support, and time instead of asking it to disappear on command.
reflection: What would kind attention to this hurt look like?

title: Four of Swords
upright: Rest before your thoughts demand it for you.
reversed: Avoiding the issue by retreating indefinitely.
interpretation: Stillness can repair your ability to think. Set a pause with a return point and let the mind unclench.
reflection: What kind of rest would restore clarity?

title: Five of Swords
upright: Question the cost of winning this exchange.
reversed: Defeat made into identity; repeating a cruel contest.
interpretation: A victory can leave the room poorer. Step back from scorekeeping and decide what respect requires now.
reflection: Which argument could end without another blow?

title: Six of Swords
upright: Move toward calmer ground with what you have learned.
reversed: Transition resisted; carrying every old fear.
interpretation: The crossing may feel quiet rather than triumphant. Accept help, take the necessary baggage, and leave the rest on shore.
reflection: What are you ready to carry across, and what can stay?

title: Seven of Swords
upright: Use strategy with integrity.
reversed: Secrecy that erodes trust; a plan exposed.
interpretation: Privacy and cunning can protect a good purpose, yet evasions accumulate a cost. Check whose trust your tactic asks you to spend.
reflection: Where would directness simplify the plan?

title: Eight of Swords
upright: Test the limits that feel absolute.
reversed: A new exit ignored; fear of first steps.
interpretation: Some constraints are real, and some tighten when you stop checking them. Find one safe movement and see what the ground permits.
reflection: Which restriction could you verify today?

title: Nine of Swords
upright: Bring a private worry into gentle daylight.
reversed: Rumination; seeking certainty from sleeplessness.
interpretation: Thoughts grow louder in the dark. Write down the specific concern, rest if you can, and invite another perspective.
reflection: Who or what could help you carry this worry?

title: Ten of Swords
upright: Acknowledge a hard ending and the dawn beyond it.
reversed: Refusing the ending; turning pain into a permanent story.
interpretation: The old line has reached its limit. Care for the injury, stop asking it to continue, and notice the first light at the edge.
reflection: What support helps you close this chapter?

title: Page of Swords
upright: Ask sharp questions and stay teachable.
reversed: Suspicion posing as wisdom.
interpretation: An alert mind sees patterns quickly. Verify them, welcome correction, and use your voice to learn rather than score.
reflection: What question would help more than an assumption?

title: Knight of Swords
upright: Pursue an idea with disciplined speed.
reversed: A rush that cuts past people.
interpretation: Urgency can clear a path when it knows its target. Check the facts and the people affected before charging ahead.
reflection: Where does speed need one deliberate check?

title: Queen of Swords
upright: Speak plainly from earned discernment.
reversed: Guardedness; wit used to wound.
interpretation: Clarity can be both firm and humane. Trust your experience and leave room for evidence that changes your view.
reflection: What boundary can you state without cruelty?

title: King of Swords
upright: Make decisions through reason and responsibility.
reversed: Rigid judgment; intellect detached from people.
interpretation: A sound decision can explain its evidence and its stakes. Use authority to make thought accountable to lived effects.
reflection: Who bears the outcome of this decision?

title: Ace of Pentacles
upright: Plant a practical opportunity carefully.
reversed: An opening missed; security sought without action.
interpretation: A tangible seed is in your hands. Give it soil, a modest plan, and time to become more than a promising object.
reflection: What small investment can you make today?

title: Two of Pentacles
upright: Balance moving demands with a flexible rhythm.
reversed: Juggling beyond capacity; a choice deferred.
interpretation: Life has more than one current. Adjust the rhythm and decide which responsibility needs a firmer place.
reflection: What can be simplified to make balance real?

title: Three of Pentacles
upright: Build well with other people's expertise.
reversed: Working alone to protect control.
interpretation: The craft improves when different skills meet. Make the plan visible, listen to the person nearest the work, and honor contribution.
reflection: Whose skill would improve this effort?

title: Four of Pentacles
upright: Protect resources while keeping them in motion.
reversed: Clinging; fear disguised as planning.
interpretation: A reserve can support freedom, yet a locked hand cannot also receive. Decide what truly needs safeguarding and what can circulate.
reflection: Where has caution become a grip?

title: Five of Pentacles
upright: Seek warmth and practical help in a hard season.
reversed: Shame that keeps support at a distance.
interpretation: Scarcity can narrow the view. Look for the lit doorway, name a concrete need, and allow help to reach you.
reflection: What help could you ask for plainly?

title: Six of Pentacles
upright: Give and receive with attention to power.
reversed: Generosity with strings; a need hidden by pride.
interpretation: An exchange can restore dignity when both sides remain visible. Notice who chooses the terms and make the balance kinder.
reflection: How can this exchange respect everyone involved?

title: Seven of Pentacles
upright: Assess the growth before changing course.
reversed: Impatience; tending a plan past its season.
interpretation: Work needs intervals of observation. Measure what is growing, change what is failing, and resist digging up the roots each day.
reflection: What evidence would tell you to persist or pivot?

title: Eight of Pentacles
upright: Practice the craft one honest repetition at a time.
reversed: Perfectionism; labor without learning.
interpretation: Skill gathers in the marks of repeated work. Set a useful standard, make one more piece, and inspect what improved.
reflection: Which repetition would teach you the most?

title: Nine of Pentacles
upright: Enjoy a freedom you have cultivated.
reversed: Isolation inside success; ease treated as a test.
interpretation: The garden reflects long care. Let yourself receive its pleasures and share from abundance without losing your independence.
reflection: What earned ease can you allow yourself?

title: Ten of Pentacles
upright: Think beyond today's gain toward shared legacy.
reversed: Family expectations overriding present needs.
interpretation: Resources can become a shelter across generations. Ask what should be preserved, who belongs, and what needs to change.
reflection: What do you hope your work makes possible for others?

title: Page of Pentacles
upright: Study a promising material path.
reversed: Endless preparation; losing wonder in details.
interpretation: A practical lesson has your attention. Start as a learner, record what works, and let a small project become your classroom.
reflection: What could you learn by making one prototype?

title: Knight of Pentacles
upright: Advance through reliable, thoughtful work.
reversed: Routine without purpose; stubborn pace.
interpretation: Consistency can carry more than a dramatic burst. Check that the destination still matters, then take the next grounded step.
reflection: What dependable action would help most today?

title: Queen of Pentacles
upright: Care for the material world generously.
reversed: Self-neglect inside caretaking.
interpretation: Comfort grows from attention to bodies, places, and resources. Make the environment nourishing for you as well as everyone else.
reflection: What practical care do you need yourself?

title: King of Pentacles
upright: Manage abundance with integrity and perspective.
reversed: Possession mistaken for worth.
interpretation: Good stewardship turns resources into durable wellbeing. Let success be measured by the life it supports and the trust it earns.
reflection: What would responsible prosperity look like here?
